comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
NPC Name: Traveling Merchant
NPC Location: Omaha, near square/train
Found only on certain days of the NA event cycle.

Contains these Box no.3 specific items:
Guardian's Hat x1
Shipwright's Hammer x1
Doctoral Thesis on Navigation (10k points) x1,
Exquisite Peacock Feather-Work x1,
Exquisite Dye x1,
Bannock (+30 vig) x50

And these items, which are common to all mystery bonanza boxes
Large Ship Blueprint x1,
Wind King's Pendant x1,
Veil of Dominions x1,
Purchase Order (Category 1) x10
Purchase Order (Category 2) x10,
Purchase Order (Category 3) x10,
Purchase Order (Category 4) x10

Guardian's Hat is memorial album entry for the "Rare Items Traveled by Train" MA (new MA that gives Dragoon Revolver, 60att handgun +2 gunfire +2 sniping +2 arms)

The same NPC who sells this box also sells the red Western Gloves (2 disguise 10att 4def 50dura, +1 marching, 500 fame req) for 10,000 ducats and Loud Bomb for 500 ducats.
